mission: Establish command, assign roles, and chart a direct course to Veranthos before Veraine arrives with complete calibration data.
why_now: The midpoint breach has shattered the group's assumptions. Ben must impose order on four incompatible reactions and chart a course to Veranthos before Veraine arrives. Gavran's note surfaces because Ben is searching the archive for alternatives.
conflict: Ben vs. the group's fractured confidence — forging a plan from four incompatible revelations
turning_point: Sera's trust moment: 'Tell me where to stand, Skywalker.' Gavran's resonance note discovered — the seed of the solution planted.
setting: Aboard Steady Returns, in transit toward Veranthos
emotional_trajectory: Leadership under uncertainty as a form of faith
notes: Ben sets direct course to Veranthos. Assigns roles. Sera's trust moment: 'Tell me where to stand, Skywalker.' Unity real but fragile. Gavran's resonance note discovered.
